summary: This directory serves as the dedicated test suite for verifying the logic used to construct directory architectural concepts. It ensures that the mechanism for analyzing file structures and inferring organizational purposes functions correctly through automated unit testing.
responsibilities: Verify the logic for building architectural concepts from file directories
Ensure consistent generation of directory metadata for testing purposes
Validate the correctness of inferred directory structures
relationships: The test suite validates the logic responsible for mapping file structures to architectural concepts.
The directory concept acts as the primary data object being verified by the test logic.
designDecisions: Co-location of testing logic with the relevant functional components
Unit testing strategy to isolate directory analysis logic
Automated validation of object schema adherence
